principles: a mechanically confirmed setup is not an executable trade
a model assumption is not a source rule
a lifecycle run with substituted manual decisions is a model study, not a strategy backtest
the original strategy and the platform research portfolio policy stay separate
no live activation, no orders, no broker

modelAssumptions.why: relative priority, earnings quality, VCP validity (SEPA) and the strong-volume judgment (Power Play) are manual by the source; a simulation can only run if they are substituted, so every simulated trade is a MODEL study, never a strategy backtest. Product outputs never substitute (state ENTRY_POSSIBLE_PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW).

modelAssumptions.reference: high of the last confirmed swing high of the base (sf3 VCP convention, +-5 sessions)
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-VCP-07 names the pivot, not its construction

modelAssumptions.reference: VCP_FOOTPRINT_STRICT: >= 2 contractions, contracting left to right, last contraction volume below the 50-day mean
modelAssumptions.why: VCP validity is manual (MIN-MR-VCP); counts and halving are typical, not limits (MIN-VCP-02/03); the strict proxy narrows the source (flat bases MIN-VCP-04 are excluded), the loose one widens it

modelAssumptions.reference: STRUCTURE: SEPA lowest low of the last contraction, Power Play lowest low of the consolidation
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-RISK-01 requires a stop before the entry and MIN-MM-STOP-02 bounds it at 10 %; the placement inside the bound is the reviewer's

modelAssumptions.reference: BUY_STOP_LIMIT: buy stop at the pivot, limit at stop / 0.9 (the price at which the planned loss reaches 10 %)
modelAssumptions.why: the sources give no order type; the limit is the consequence of MIN-MM-STOP-02 for a gap; the market variant keeps gap fills and flags the exceeded planned loss

modelAssumptions.reference: INTRADAY_PRICE_FIRST: the buy stop fills on the breakout bar (MIN-MM-VOL-EX)
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-VCP-07 "with increasing volume" is a strong preference; daily bars cannot know the volume of the breakout bar at the fill, so the volume-confirmed reading enters at the next open (volume above the 50-day mean, one of the two sf3 readings)

modelAssumptions.reference: PESSIMISTIC: on an intraday pivot fill with a low at or below the stop on the same bar the stop is assumed hit after the fill
modelAssumptions.why: a daily bar does not show whether the low came before or after the pivot touch; gap and limit fills are unambiguous and not affected

modelAssumptions.reference: RE_EVALUATED_EACH_CLOSE: an order is valid for the next session only and is re-armed while the setup holds at the close
modelAssumptions.why: no setup lifetime in #709; re-evaluation adds no number and invalidates a setup as soon as its own definition fails (Trend Template, correction, pivot exceeded)

modelAssumptions.reference: DATE_SEEDED_HASH: simultaneous fills are booked in the order of FNV-1a(date|security id) (minervini-execution#fillRank), neutral and deterministic; a plain security-id order would favour alphabetically early names in a capital-bound book
modelAssumptions.why: relative priority is manual (MIN-PROCESS-04); the neutral order is deterministic, capital-constrained rejections are counted so its influence stays visible

modelAssumptions.reference: STOP_BE3R_MA50: initial stop, stop to break-even at 3R on a close (MIN-RISK-05), after break-even a close below MA50 exits at the next open (MIN-TTC-TRAIL / MIN-MM-SELL-02)
modelAssumptions.why: sell rules are manual (MIN-SF-SELL); the reference uses only the mechanical parts of the printed sell guides; the free-roll is the OPTIONAL MIN-TTC-FREEROLL example at both printed ends of 2-3R

modelAssumptions.reference: the Stage 2 context of a base (MIN-BASE-01) is read as "Trend Template 1-7 holds on the setup close"
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-BASE-01 names the Stage 2 context without a mechanical test; the Trend Template is the source's own upstream qualification (MIN-PROCESS-01)

modelAssumptions.reference: Power Play pivot = run-up high (highest high of the consolidation), as in powerPlayClassify
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-PP-02..05 describe run-up and consolidation, not the pivot

modelAssumptions.reference: only CONFIRMED_MECHANICAL_SETUP is simulated; MANUAL_REVIEW_SETUP and DATA_BLOCKED_SETUP stay blocked
modelAssumptions.why: no automatic upgrade of manual or data-blocked setups (owner decision 2026-10-21); a confirmed setup still needs the separate eligibility

modelAssumptions.reference: VU_TOURNAMENT_UNIVERSE_705 at the prior session (raw close >= 5, 20-day dollar volume >= 1 million)
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-MM-LIQ-01 and MIN-MM-PRC-01 are context and preferences without a hard floor; the pre-registered research universe is shared by every source-faithful method

modelAssumptions.reference: a low at or below the stop exits at min(open, stop) (gap through the stop: the open)
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-MM-STOP-01 executes the stop regardless of volume; the fill on a daily bar is the sf3 convention (sellEvidence)

modelAssumptions.reference: 10 bps slippage per side, 1 bp commission (research-v1 convention of the snapshot runs)
modelAssumptions.why: no costs in the sources; identical to the Turtle research runs so that methods stay comparable

modelAssumptions.reference: research-v1: orders only on real source bars, stale limit 5 sessions -> SECURITY_UNAVAILABLE, economic delisting by the S0 scenario, dividends on held shares, ledger replay
modelAssumptions.why: platform accounting (validation/accounting-contract.mjs), not a Minervini rule

modelAssumptions.reference: at most 20 open positions (platform research portfolio policy)
modelAssumptions.why: MIN-RISK-10 "not more than 20 positions" (2013) is a strong preference, not a hard rule; used as the cap of the platform policy, not as an original rule

modelAssumptions.reference: 0.0125 of equity (the boundary shared by MIN-MM-SIZE-03 and MIN-MM-SIZE-04)
modelAssumptions.why: the risk per trade is the reviewer's; the printed ranges are context (0.75-1.25 % average, 1.25-2.5 % typical, at most 2.5 %)

notModelled: exposure build-up from pilot buys (MIN-RISK-02/03, MIN-MM-SIZE-02)
risk reduction after poor own results (MIN-RISK-04)
margin and exposure in difficult markets (MIN-RISK-07/08)
typical 4-6 positions (MIN-RISK-09) and concentration (MIN-TTC-CONCENTRATION): preferences, reported as diagnostics
exit liquidity (MIN-MM-LIQ-01): participation is reported, not limited
